name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns ran, spending $42.10 across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, but neither produced any leads.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet had $0.00 spend, 0 impressions, and 0 clicks — it did not serve at all on November 3, 2026. All activity came from Dedicated night runs: $42.10 spend, 2,300 impressions, 19 clicks, and a 0.8% click rate.
No leads came in from either campaign, so there is no cost per lead to report. November 2026 has 28 days left, with $42.10 spent so far on Meta.
The 2026-09-28 mature cohort shows the strongest funnel: 40 leads, 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-09-21 mature cohort is close behind: 38 leads, 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 0 hired, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge: leads are still moving through the funnel.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
